units_checked.description: ids (document paths) of every unit in your batch that you actually read

unit.description: the document path, exactly as the unit id in the batch

text.description: what the prose says, what the output shows, and where (doc line, chunk index)

doc_line.description: line of the prose in the document

chunk.description: index of the chunk whose output is the evidence

old_text.description: number-drift: a fragment of ONE prose line, copied exactly, that contains the number once

old_number.description: number-drift: the number as written in old_text

new_number.description: number-drift: the number the output supports, written the way the prose writes numbers

output_line.description: number-drift: the line of recorded output, copied exactly, that shows the new number
